tools.name: sun_times
tools.description: Sunrise, sunset, solar noon and day length at a place on a day (today by default), with how much longer or shorter the day is than the day before, civil, nautical and astronomical twilight, and the golden and blue hours for photos. Local clock time, to the minute.

tools.name: sun_calendar
tools.description: Sunrise, sunset and day length for every day of a month at a place, with the change of the day length from day to day; the link opens the same calendar to print on one A4 page.

tools.name: moon_times
tools.description: Moonrise and moonset at a place on a day (today by default), the moon's phase and lit part, a new or full moon or quarter that day, and the next new and full moon.

tools.name: moon_phases
tools.description: The new moons, first quarters, full moons and last quarters between two dates (two years at most; from today for 60 days by default), to the minute in a time zone (Polish time by default).

tools.name: clock_change
tools.description: When the clocks change in Poland in a year (this year by default): the dates, which way and at what time, and the next change from today.

tools.name: solstice
tools.description: The December and June solstices of a year (this year by default) to the minute, Polish time; with a place, also its shortest and longest day, the earliest sunset and the latest sunrise of the winter.

tools.name: find_city
tools.description: The site's places whose name starts with the text (Polish or English names, with or without Polish letters): 258 places (Polish cities, places for trips and a few cities abroad), with coordinates, time zone and page.
